name: Epic (Nemirtingas Epic Emulator)
notes: Auto-selected when EOSSDK-Win64-Shipping.dll or EOSSDK-Win32-Shipping.dll is found anywhere in the game folder. No bundled asset pack: write_config.ps1 downloads and caches Nemirtingas EpicEmulatorRegistry releases from GitLab under %SystemDrive%\steamcmd\_Epic\NemirtingasEpicEmu on first run. The Epic namespace/sandboxId is looked up from egdata.app by game name (epic_namespace_lookup.ps1)
